findings.body: If `placedMesh(source)` retains the original positions, `restorePreAlignment` replaces the source arrays, and `updateMeshColors` then copies that source before release, the new copy records only the replacement buffers. `releaseGeometryMemory` releases that copy, so its buffer membership does not include the original positions still held by the placed mesh; the earlier CPU allocation remains live.
